Prince William Announces Earthshot Prize Finalists

Prince William has announced the finalists for the Earthshot Prize, an environmental award he founded. Among the finalists are ranger teams from Central Australia recognized for their work in bushfire management, species protection, and land practices developed over tens of thousands of years. The Spanish city of Barcelona is also a finalist for its plan to protect its coastline. The finalists expressed a mix of nervousness and excitement about their recognition.
